s.en: Provide a UDP receiver that gets packets from network devices (like Aruba routers) and exports them in PCAP format.

o.en: List configuration options of specified interface.
Start capturing from specified interface save saved it in place specified by --fifo.
Save captured packet to file or send it through pipe.
Set the listener port. Port 5555 is the default.
Set the payload of the exported PDU. Default: data.
